Collecting a <stasis/>Stasis Shard <title refills [G_refill] /> the magazine.

While Creeping Attrition is active, Precision Kills or <stasis/>Shattering a <stasis/>Stasis Crystal spawns a Small <stasis/>Stasis Shard which tracks back to you. 

2 second cooldown between generating additional <stasis/>Stasis Shards.
